rule: Purpose-first invitation; never imply endorsement, attendance or partnership until accepted in writing.

targets.subject: Invitation to help launch a WorldzTravelParTy™ Dubbo community week
targets.draft: Hello P!NK team — I’m Jason Wright / JayJayTeamDev, creator of OneWorldz, CryptoWorldz and the emerging WorldzParTyPlatform. I’m planning a purpose-first Dubbo community week as part of WorldzTravelParTy™ 2026–2030: music, builders, learning, local businesses and practical community action. P!NK is a dream invitation because of the scale, heart and all-ages energy she brings to live events. This is not being advertised as a confirmed appearance. I’m asking whether your team would be open to receiving a proper event brief once venue, dates, Council approvals, budget and production capability are ready. The wider OneWorldz mission is Helping the People who Help the People.

targets.subject: Dubbo WorldzParTy Week™ invitation — Jay’s 50th-year homecoming concept
